justification: Assessment returned INVALID and identified exactly the ground-truth defect: the induction step treats dist[] values read during a pass as frozen end-of-previous-iteration values, so the loop invariant is stated as an equality when in-place relaxation only preserves dist[u] <= OPT_k(u). Its witness (s->a=1, a->u=1, s->u=10; order (s,a),(a,u),(s,u)) is a different-but-valid instance of the same failure: after one pass dist[a]=1, then a->u reads the updated value giving dist[u]=2, while the only <=1-edge s-u path is s->u of length 10, so the claimed equality fails with dist[u] < OPT_1(u) — same direction and same mechanism as the ground-truth witness.
